subject.title: [Bug] LINE channel inbound events were delayed before agent run and later drained

question: Should LINE receive diagnostics remain structured logs only, or should this work also expose receivedAt through the generic agent/session inbound contract tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/53678?
rationale: The evidence supports an observability gap but does not prove an internal queue defect, and deciding whether receive timing becomes agent-visible metadata is an API and product-boundary choice.

options.title: Diagnostics plus generic timestamp
options.body: Add LINE event-id, redelivery, and latency diagnostics while coordinating agent-visible receivedAt through the existing generic inbound contract.

options.title: LINE diagnostics only
options.body: Add structured LINE receive and redelivery logging without changing agent-visible inbound metadata.

options.title: Await recurrence evidence
options.body: Defer code changes until LINE Console or front-proxy records conclusively locate another delayed event.

recommendation.title: Diagnostics plus generic timestamp
recommendation.body: Add LINE event-id, redelivery, and latency diagnostics while coordinating agent-visible receivedAt through the existing generic inbound contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The LINE feature history identifies steipete as the implementation completer and merger best positioned to decide the plugin-versus-generic contract boundary.
